name: Microsoft
hook: The software giant behind Windows, Office and Bing — and the Bill Gates story Jeopardy loves.

facts.label: Bill Gates & Paul Allen
facts.statement: Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded Microsoft; an $84 purchase at its March 13, 1986 IPO grew to over $30,000 by 2006.

facts.label: Bill Gates
facts.statement: Bill Gates co-founded Microsoft, wrote The Road Ahead, and was long ranked the world's richest person, ahead of Warren Buffett.

facts.label: Melinda Gates
facts.statement: Melinda Gates joined Microsoft in 1987, the year she earned an MBA from Duke, and now co-chairs the Gates Foundation.

facts.label: IBM PC
facts.statement: In 1981 IBM's PC used an operating system from Microsoft, after Bill Gates's mother helped convince IBM to hire the company.

facts.label: Windows Vista
facts.statement: Windows Vista, released in 2007, opens with a startup sound Robert Fripp spent 18 months creating.

facts.label: Bing
facts.statement: Bing replaced Microsoft Live Search in 2009; its AI technology comes from OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT.

facts.label: Skype
facts.statement: Microsoft bought Skype in 2011 for more than $8 billion.
